intent_summary: The CLI analyzes CSV, JSON requests, and bare JSON values from files or stdin, with configurable settings and protected output files.

criteria.criterion: The methods command lists supported analysis recipes and residual detectors.
criteria.notes: Discovery tests check all three recipes and ten residual detectors, with structured stdout and no successful-run diagnostics on stderr.

criteria.criterion: Equivalent file and stdin JSON inputs produce equivalent request fingerprints and analysis semantics.
criteria.notes: The passing file/stdin regression compares request fingerprints and short-history semantics; cross-interface tests compare complete stable numerical output.

criteria.criterion: CSV supports positional or timestamped selected values, treats empty cells as missing, and rejects varying unmapped entity columns.
criteria.notes: The passing CSV regression covers timestamped missing cells, positional data, and varying unmapped entity rejection.

criteria.criterion: Settings resolve in embedded-request, settings-file, then CLI-flag precedence; bare JSON values can use CLI configuration.
criteria.notes: The passing file/flag/embedded precedence regression and bare-values regression establish the merge order and validated configuration.

criteria.criterion: Output files require explicit overwrite permission, and invalid input is distinguished from execution failure by exit status.
criteria.notes: Output protection and exit regressions passed, including explicit overwrite; successful manual examples have empty stderr and incomplete-usage exits 1.
